description: Flexible emit-argument coverage: an entry with only a level and nothing else is still recorded with empty source, message, and validity segments; a deferred producer combined with an explicit source preserves the source while taking the message from the producer; an explicit message together with a producer keeps the explicit message and ignores the producer; and an entry whose message is null but which carries a source promotes the source value into the message, leaving the source segment empty.
